name: Ridgefield Academy & Landmark Preschool Summer Programs (Camp RA / Camp Landmark / Explorer Programs)
description_short: Summer programs at Ridgefield Academy and Landmark Preschool in Ridgefield that mix hands-on academics, creative arts and outdoor play. Camp Landmark serves ages 2 to 4, Camp RA serves children entering kindergarten to Grade 3, and Explorer Programs serve Grades 4 to 8. 2027 dates are not posted yet.

warnings: Out-of-date page: it says planning is underway for the 2026 Summer Program, but today is 2026-10-13, so that season has ended. Nothing is posted for 2027.
No sessions, dates or prices are posted. The page is mainly a 'Notify Me When Enrollment Opens' form.
'Currently Enrolling: Camp Landmark Ridgefield (Ages 2 - 4), Camp RA (K - Grade 3)' probably refers to the old 2026 season. Don't take it as 2027 availability.
The ages conflict: the intro says 'ages 3 through Grade 8', but the interest form lists Camp Landmark for 2s–4s, so age_min was left blank.
The page covers several campuses (Bedford, NY and Westport, CT for Camp Landmark). This listing uses the Ridgefield, CT address.
Camp type 'day' is inferred because RA is a day school with preschool-age programs. The page doesn't state it directly.
